title: temporal nr gate on render class

commit.merge_subject: merge: temporal nr gate on render class

description:
Measured on the owner's device (2026-11-13, 37s window, HIGH
preview quality): 135 settle-class-rate renders = 3.65 renders/sec
(~274 ms/frame) while the position advanced +8 frames per render —
choppy ~3.6fps playback. Cause: the temporal NR gate
(temporalNrAppliesAt, maxDim >= 1280) keyed on TIER SIZE alone, and
PreviewQuality.HIGH makes the playback tier 1280, so every playback
render silently ran the temporal merge — a full-res CFA pass measured
at ~85-107 ms/frame, tier-INDEPENDENT (proxy 0.8-2.2 + match 7.9-12.1
+ merge 76.7-93.1 ms, 4K fixture desktop -O2), roughly a third of the
274ms. The tier ladder predates the HIGH quality level; when HIGH made
playback 1280-capable, the tier-size gate could no longer tell a
playback render from a settle render.

Fix: gate on the render CLASS, not just the tier size. New minimal
PreviewTiers.RenderClass {DRAG, SETTLE, PLAYBACK} — no existing
changed: fix: temporal nr gate on render class
